startingRoom.name: Entrance Hall
startingRoom.description: You find yourself in a dim room with a stone table to your east. You see an unbreakable door with a strong, gilded lock to your west. A long corridor is northward.

corridor.name: Long Corridor
corridor.description: A long, straight corridor. A large room awaits you to the north.

items.name: Torch
items.description: A stone-shafted torch with a baby flame at the tip

octagon.name: Octagon
octagon.description: A large octagonal-shaped chamber. To the north is a gated pathway. You see doorways both west and east.

items.name: Pile of Gold Coins
items.description: A stack of glimmering gold coins

items.name: Monarch's Crown
items.description: A king's crown, with gold plating and jewels lining the bottom

monsters.name: Troll
monsters.description: A troll stands guarding the treasure

control_room.name: Control Room Entrance
control_room.description: The entrance to an unkempt office area, full of useless papers and empty chairs. There is a hallway to the west, a room entrance to the north, and a large room to the east.

control_hallway.name: Control Room Hallway
control_hallway.description: A hallway connected to mulitple offices. To your south is an office with an unlocked door. Eastwards leads to the entrance of the control room.

warden_office.name: Warden's Office
warden_office.description: An unkempt office area, full of useless papers and empty chairs. You see a water dispenser further into the office.

items.name: Warden's Key
items.description: A black key with a sleek, fancy design.

armory.name: Armory
armory.description: A room with broken armor pieces scattered on the floor.
